主要内容: The global Insurtech market is projected to grow significantly from USD 1462.3 million in 2020 to USD 11940 million by 2027, at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 34.4% during the period 2021-2027. Key players in the market include Quantemplate, Slice, Neos, Shift Technology, Lemonade, Oscar Health, Acko General Insurance, and ZhongAn. The report highlights the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the market and provides insights into regional analysis, market segments, and future trends. The report also includes information on market dynamics, challenges, and opportunities for key players.
